sentences.text: Numenius of Apamea was a Greek philosopher , who lived in Apamea in Syria and flourished during the latter half of the 2nd century AD .	Apamea	Apamea (Syria)	Syria	Syria
He was a Neopythagorean and forerunner of the Neoplatonists .	Neopythagorean	Neopythagorean
